answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The atlas of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The whisper holds work receipts rather than names, so the ferrous of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
